---

When young, looked forward to a time when life would be free from work, engagements, and obligations.

As I age, the yearning for freedom has been replaced.

I seek for meaning.

Meaning that is found in structured, constrained life.

---

Freedom is to be found in work.

Not free from obligations but while engaged.

young ones know this principle instinctively

Steven Covey described the situation when his daughter refused to share the birthday gifts her friends had given her just moments earlier.

After negotiating and trying to influence her, he finally took away the gifts from her daughter and gave to other kids.

But that is the premise of the communism.
